name: io.logto.sdk.android.auth.logto.LogtoRedirectReceiverActivity
description: When a browser returns to the app through a Logto sign-in link, the Logto Android SDK opens this exported callback screen. It checks the returned link and forwards it to the in-progress sign-in.
disableEffect: Users may not complete browser-based Logto sign-in because the callback will not be received.
